key_insight: A vision transformer with attention was used to classify narrow-band laryngeal endoscopy images as benign or malignant while adding segmentation-based explanation for clinicians.
clinical_relevance: This could help support earlier laryngeal cancer screening and reduce variability in interpretation of NBI endoscopy images.
method: Transformer/attention model analyzes narrow-band imaging endoscopy images
MedSAM segmentation highlights pathologic regions for explainability
Combines classification and segmentation in one screening workflow
evidence_signal: The abstract reports F1 of 82.72% and accuracy of 82.33% for benign-versus-malignant classification.
watch_item: Performance comes from a limited abstract summary, so real-world usefulness still depends on external validation, workflow integration, and clinician oversight.
paper_title: Medical Imaging Fusing Vision Transformer: Laryngeal Cancer Screening with Explanation
